papers.title: MonkeyOCR v1.5 Technical Report: Unlocking Robust Document Parsing for Complex Patterns
papers.authors: Jiarui Zhang, Yuliang Liu, Zijun Wu, Guosheng Pang, Zhili Ye, Yupei Zhong, Junteng Ma, Tao Wei, Haiyang Xu, Weikai Chen, Zeen Wang, Qiangjun Ji, Fanxi Zhou, Qi Zhang, Yuanrui Hu, Jiahao Liu, Zhang Li, Ziyang Zhang, Qiang Liu, Xiang Bai
papers.affiliations: 1 KingSoft Office Zhuiguang AI Lab, 2 Huazhong University of Science and Technology
papers.intro: 本文提出MonkeyOCR v1.5，一个两阶段视觉-语言文档解析框架，通过视觉一致性强化学习、图像解耦表格解析和类型引导表格合并，在复杂文档场景下取得最先进性能。

papers.title: Text-based Aerial-Ground Person Retrieval
papers.authors: Xinyu Zhou, Yu Wu, Jiayao Ma, Wenhao Wang, Min Cao, Mang Ye
papers.affiliations: Soochow University（苏州大学）、AgiBot、Wuhan University（武汉大学）
papers.intro: 论文首次提出文本驱动的空地行人检索任务（TAG-PR），构建了包含多样视角的 TAG-PEDES 数据集，并提出了 TAG-CLIP 框架，通过层级路由混合专家模块和视角解耦策略，有效处理航拍与地面视角下的文本-图像跨模态检索问题。

papers.title: Grounding Computer Use Agents on Human Demonstrations
papers.authors: Aarash Feizi, Shravan Nayak, Xiangru Jian, Kevin Qinghong Lin, Kaixin Li, Rabiul Awal, Xing Han Lù, Johan Obando-Ceron, Juan A. Rodriguez, Nicolas Chapados, David Vazquez, Adriana Romero-Soriano, Reihaneh Rabbany, Perouz Taslakian, Christopher Pal, Spandana Gella, Sai Rajeswar

papers.intro: 本文提出GROUNDCUA，一个由专家人类演示构建的大规模桌面接地数据集（覆盖87个应用、3.56M+标注），并基于该数据集训练GROUNDNEXT系列视觉语言模型，通过监督微调和强化学习在多个基准上取得最先进结果，且训练数据量远小于先前工作。

papers.title: GUI-360°: A Comprehensive Dataset and Benchmark for Computer-Using Agents
papers.authors: Jian Mu, Chaoyun Zhang, Chiming Ni, Lu Wang, Bo Qiao, Kartik Mathur, Qianhui Wu, Yuhang Xie, Xiaojun Ma, Mengyu Zhou, Si Qin, Liqun Li, Yu Kang, Minghua Ma, Qingwei Lin, Saravan Rajmohan, Dongmei Zhang
papers.affiliations: 1Nanjing University, 2Microsoft, 3ZJU-UIUC, 4Peking University
papers.intro: 本文提出GUI-360°，一个包含超过120万执行步骤、覆盖Windows办公应用（Word、Excel、PowerPoint）的大规模数据集和基准套件，统一支持GUI grounding、screen parsing和action prediction三个任务，并提供自动化的LLM增强采集管道及混…

papers.title: PCD-ReID: Occluded Person Re-Identification for Base Station Inspection
papers.authors: Ge Gao, Zishuo Gao, Hongyan Cui, Zhiyang Jia, Zhuang Luo, ChaoPeng Liu
papers.affiliations: China University of Petroleum (Beijing) at Karamay; Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications
papers.intro: 本文提出了一种基于Transformer和Triplet Attention的PCD-ReID算法，并结合新收集的基站巡检真实监控数据集（MyTT2），有效解决了遮挡场景下巡检人员的重识别问题，在自建测试集上取得了mAP 79.0%、Rank-1 82.7%的性能。

papers.title: Vision Transformer for Robust Occluded Person Reidentification in Complex Surveillance Scenes
papers.authors: Bo Li, Duyuan Zheng, Xinyang Liu, Qingwen Li, Hong Li, Hongyan Cui, Ge Gao, Chen Liu
papers.affiliations: China Tower Corporation Limited; China University of Petroleum-Beijing at Karamay; Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications（详见第十二节）
papers.intro: 本文提出 Sh-ViT（Shuffling Vision Transformer），一种基于 ViT-Base 的轻量级鲁棒行人重识别模型，通过引入 Shuffle 模块、场景自适应数据增强和 DeiT 知识蒸馏，在遮挡、模糊及视角畸变的复杂监控场景中显著提升识别性能，并构建了真实基站场景数据集 M…

papers.title: OSWorld-MCP: Benchmarking MCP Tool Invocation In Computer-Use Agents
papers.authors: Hongrui Jia, Jitong Liao, Xi Zhang, Haiyang Xu, Tianbao Xie, Chaoya Jiang, Ming Yan, Si Liu, Wei Ye, Fei Huang
papers.affiliations: Peking University (作者1,6,9), Tongyi Lab, Alibaba Group (作者1-5,7,10), Beijing Zhongguancun Academy (作者8)
papers.intro: 提出了OSWorld-MCP，第一个在真实计算机环境中综合评估多模态代理的MCP工具调用、GUI操作和决策能力的公平基准，包含158个高质量MCP工具，覆盖7个常用应用，实验表明MCP工具能提升任务成功率，但当前模型工具调用率仍较低（最高仅36.3%）。

papers.title: Surfer 2: The Next Generation of Cross-Platform Computer Use Agents
papers.authors: Mathieu Andreux, Märt Bakler, Yanael Barbier, Hamza Benchekroun, Emilien Biré, Antoine Bonnet, Riaz Bordie, Nathan Bout, Matthias Brunel, Aleix Cambray, Pierre-Louis Cedoz, Antoine Chassang, Gautier Cloix, Ethan Connelly, Alexandra Constantinou, Ramzi De Coster, Hubert de la Jonquiere, Aurélien Delfosse, Maxime Delpit, Alexis Deprez, Augustin Derupti, Mathieu Diaz, Shannon D'Souza, Julie Dujardin, Abai Edmund, Michael Eickenberg, Armand Fatalot, Wissem Felissi, Isaac Herring, Xavier Koegler, Erwan Le Jumeau de Kergaradec, Aurélien Lac, Maxime Langevin, Corentin Lauverjat, Antonio Loison, Avshalom Manevich, Axel Moyal, Axel Nguyen Kerbel, Marinela Parovic, Julien Revelle, Guillaume Richard, Mats Richter, Ronan Riochet, María Santos, Romain Savidan, Laurent Sifre, Maxime Theillard, Marc Thibault, Ivan Valentini, Tony Wu, Laura Yie, Kai Yuan, Jevgenij Zubovskij
papers.tags: visual grounding, object detection, scene understanding, gui
papers.affiliations: H Company — Alphabetical order
papers.intro: 论文提出Surfer 2，一种仅基于视觉观察的统一层次化代理架构，通过分层上下文管理、解耦规划与执行、自验证与自适应恢复机制，在Web、桌面和移动四大基准上达到SOTA性能，无需任务特定微调即可超越人类水平。

papers.title: VideoAgentTrek: Computer Use Pretraining from Unlabeled Videos
papers.authors: Dunjie Lu, Yiheng Xu, Junli Wang, Haoyuan Wu, Xinyuan Wang, Zekun Wang, Junlin Yang, Hongjin Su, Jixuan Chen, Junda Chen, Yuchen Mao, Jingren Zhou, Junyang Lin, Binyuan Hui, Tao Yu
papers.tags: gui, object detection, YOLO, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: The University of Hong Kong, Qwen Team, Alibaba Group
papers.intro: 本文提出 VideoAgentTrek，一个无需人工标注的管道，通过逆动力学模块（Video2Action）自动将公开的屏幕录制视频转化为结构化动作轨迹，用于计算机使用智能体的预训练，在 OSWorld-Verified 和 AgentNetBench 上显著提升了任务成功率。

papers.title: CUARewardBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Reward Models on Computer-using Agent
papers.authors: Haojia Lin, Xiaoyu Tan, Yulei Qin, Zihan Xu, Yuchen Shi, Zongyi Li, Gang Li, Shaofei Cai, Siqi Cai, Chaoyou Fu, Ke Li, Xing Sun
papers.affiliations: 腾讯（Tencent）
papers.intro: 本文提出了首个面向计算机使用代理的奖励模型评估基准CUARewardBench，并基于分析发现提出了无异议提示集成（UPE）方法，显著提升了奖励模型的可靠性和评估精度。

papers.title: UltraCUA: A Foundation Model for Computer Use Agents with Hybrid Action
papers.authors: Yuhao Yang, Zhen Yang, Zi-Yi Dou, Anh Nguyen, Keen You, Omar Attia, Andrew Szot, Michael Feng, Ram Ramrakhya, Alexander Toshev, Chao Huang, Yinfei Yang, Zhe Gan
papers.affiliations: Apple, The University of Hong Kong
papers.intro: 本文提出UltraCUA，一个通过混合动作（Hybrid Action）无缝整合原始GUI操作与高级工具执行的基础模型，利用自动工具收集、合成数据引擎和两阶段训练（SFT+RL）显著提升计算机使用代理的性能与泛化能力。

papers.title: PaddleOCR-VL: Boosting Multilingual Document Parsing via a 0.9B Ultra-Compact Vision-Language Model
papers.authors: Cheng Cui, Ting Sun, Suyin Liang, Tingquan Gao, Zelun Zhang, Jiaxuan Liu, Xueqing Wang, Changda Zhou, Hongen Liu, Manhui Lin, Yue Zhang, Yubo Zhang, Handong Zheng, Jing Zhang, Jun Zhang, Yi Liu, Dianhai Yu, Yanjun Ma
papers.tags: OCR, multimodal learning, object detection, gui
papers.affiliations: PaddlePaddle Team, Baidu Inc
papers.intro: 本文提出PaddleOCR-VL，一种基于0.9B超紧凑视觉语言模型的两阶段文档解析方案，通过NaViT动态分辨率视觉编码器与轻量ERNIE-4.5-0.3B语言模型的结合，在支持109种语言的同时，在页面级和元素级文档解析任务上达到SOTA性能，且推理速度快、资源消耗低。

papers.title: Ultralytics YOLO Evolution: An Overview of YOLO26, YOLO11, YOLOv8 and YOLOv5 Object Detectors for Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition
papers.authors: Ranjan Sapkota, Manoj Karkee
papers.affiliations: Cornell University, Biological & Environmental Engineering, Ithaca, NY 14850, USA
papers.intro: 本文系统综述了Ultralytics YOLO家族从YOLOv5到YOLO26的架构演进、性能基准测试和部署视角，重点分析YOLO26中移除DFL、NMS-free推理、ProgLoss、STAL和MuSGD等创新如何实现边缘部署优化。

papers.title: Personalizing Retrieval using Joint Embeddings or "the Return of Fluffy"
papers.authors: Bruno Korbar, Andrew Zisserman
papers.tags: CLIP, image retrieval, object detection, video search
papers.affiliations: Visual Geometry Group, University of Oxford
papers.intro: 本文提出一种轻量级映射网络π-map，将局部图像嵌入“翻译”为可组合的文本标记，利用冻结的CLIP编码器实现个性化图像检索，在无需微调文本编码器的情况下显著提升两个基准上的检索性能。

papers.title: Watch and Learn: Learning to Use Computers from Online Videos
papers.authors: Chan Hee Song, Yiwen Song, Palash Goyal, Yu Su, Oriana Riva, Hamid Palangi, Tomas Pfister
papers.affiliations: Google Cloud AI Research, Google DeepMind, The Ohio State University
papers.intro: 本文提出Watch & Learn（W&L）框架，通过逆动力学模型（IDM）从互联网上的计算机使用教学视频中自动恢复可执行UI轨迹，从而为CUA提供大规模、高质量的监督数据和上下文示例。

papers.title: Scaling Agents for Computer Use
papers.authors: Gonzalo Gonzalez-Pumariega, Vincent Tu, Chih-Lun Lee, Jiachen Yang, Ang Li, Xin Eric Wang
papers.affiliations: Simular Research
papers.intro: 本文提出Behavior Judge（BJudge）框架，通过将代理执行轨迹转化为行为叙述并在此层级进行比较选择，实现多rollout的宽扩展，在OSWorld上达到72.6%的成功率，超越先前最优和人类水平。

papers.title: YOLO26: Key Architectural Enhancements and Performance Benchmarking for Real-Time Object Detection
papers.authors: Ranjan Sapkota, Rahul Harsha Cheppally, Ajay Sharda, Manoj Karkee
papers.affiliations: ¹Cornell University, Biological & Environmental Engineering, Ithaca, NY, USA；²Kansas State University, Department of Biological and Agricultural Engineering, Manhattan, KS, USA
papers.intro: 本文系统地分析和基准测试了Ultralytics YOLO26架构，该模型通过消除NMS和DFL、引入ProgLoss-STAL标签分配及MuSGD优化器，在边缘设备上实现了更高效率、更稳训练和出色的小目标检测性能。

papers.title: MinerU2.5: A Decoupled Vision-Language Model for Efficient High-Resolution Document Parsing
papers.authors: Junbo Niu, Zheng Liu, Zhuangcheng Gu, Bin Wang, Linke Ouyang, Zhiyuan Zhao, Tao Chu, Tianyao He, Fan Wu, Qintong Zhang, Zhenjiang Jin, Guang Liang, Rui Zhang, Wenzheng Zhang, Yuan Qu, Zhifei Ren, Yuefeng Sun, Yuanhong Zheng, Dongsheng Ma, Zirui Tang, Boyu Niu, Ziyang Miao, Hejun Dong, Siyi Qian, Junyuan Zhang, Jingzhou Chen, Fangdong Wang, Xiaomeng Zhao, Liqun Wei, Wei Li, Shasha Wang, Ruiliang Xu, Yuanyuan Cao, Lu Chen, Qianqian Wu, Huaiyu Gu, Lindong Lu, Keming Wang, Dechen Lin, Guanlin Shen, Xuanhe Zhou, Linfeng Zhang, Yuhang Zang, Xiaoyi Dong, Jiaqi Wang, Bo Zhang, Lei Bai, Pei Chu, Weijia Li, Jiang Wu, Lijun Wu, Zhenxiang Li, Guangyu Wang, Zhongying Tu, Chao Xu, Kai Chen, Yu Qiao, Bowen Zhou, Dahua Lin, Wentao Zhang, Conghui He
papers.affiliations: Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory, Peking University, Shanghai Jiao Tong University (具体作者隶属关系见论文正文第一页脚注)
papers.intro: MinerU2.5提出一种解耦的两阶段“粗到细”文档解析策略，先对下采样图像进行全局布局分析，再根据布局引导从原始图像裁剪局部区域进行原生分辨率细粒度识别，以仅1.2B参数实现了全面超越通用及专用模型的最新性能，同时显著降低计算开销。

papers.title: FitPro: A Zero-Shot Framework for Interactive Text-based Pedestrian Retrieval in Open World
papers.authors: Zengli Luo, Canlong Zhang, Xiaochun Lu, Zhixin Li
papers.affiliations: 广西师范大学（教育部教育区块链与智能技术重点实验室、广西多源信息挖掘与安全重点实验室）；广州中医药大学基础医学院
papers.intro: FitPro是一个面向开放世界的交互式零样本文本行人检索框架，通过特征对比解码、增量语义挖掘和查询感知分层检索三个模块，实现了跨场景泛化与多轮交互中的渐进式语义建模。

papers.title: ScaleCUA: Scaling Open-Source Computer Use Agents with Cross-Platform Data
papers.authors: Zhaoyang Liu, Jingjing Xie, Zichen Ding, Zehao Li, Bowen Yang, Zhenyu Wu, Xuehui Wang, Qiushi Sun, Shi Liu, Weiyun Wang, Shenglong Ye, Qingyun Li, Xuan Dong, Yue Yu, Chenyu Lu, YunXiang Mo, Yao Yan, Zeyue Tian, Xiao Zhang, Yuan Huang, Yiqian Liu, Weijie Su, Gen Luo, Xiangyu Yue, Biqing Qi, Kai Chen, Bowen Zhou, Yu Qiao, Qifeng Chen, Wenhai Wang
papers.tags: visual grounding, OCR, multimodal learning, gui
papers.affiliations: Shanghai AI Laboratory
papers.intro: 本文提出ScaleCUA，通过一个整合自动化代理和人类专家的闭环数据管道，构建了覆盖6个操作系统和3个任务领域的跨平台大规模数据集，并基于该数据训练了一系列统一感知、推理和行动的基础模型，在多个GUI基准上取得新SOTA结果。
